title: Carl Friedrich Gauss: Werke and Individual Papers (Modern LaTeX Working Drafts)
version: 2026-06-02 Gauss current cumulative readers plus Band II source and translation pilot
description:
Author record for Carl Friedrich Gauss in the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This page presents selected Werke volumes and individual passages as modern LaTeX working reader PDFs, with source TeX, component PDFs, compile outputs, source references, and audit reports preserved in ZIP artifacts.

Status at a glance.

  • Reader PDFs: [########--] eight broad front-facing readers are present, totaling more than 3,000 pages: Werke Bands I, I alternate, II, III, VI, VII, XI Part I, and an individual-papers grouping.
  • Band II pilot additions: [#---------] this update adds four small direct readers: source text and English translation for Theorematis arithmetici demonstratio nova Articles 5-7, and source text and English translation for the Seeber identity passage.
  • Current repair incorporation: [#########-] the cumulative rebuild includes repaired and source-checkable supplements for Disquisitiones Arithmeticae gaps, Band I alternate expansion, Band II quadratic reciprocity and Seeber material, Band III AGM formulas, Band VI chapters 8/10/11/13, Band VII chapter/article repairs, and Band XI Part I recovered material.
  • Source artifacts: [########--] TeX sources, component PDFs, compile logs, source-page references, render images, and audit reports are preserved in artifact ZIPs for inspection and continuation.
  • Proofreading state: [###-------] machine-assisted working drafts needing source comparison, theorem/reference checking, and mathematical proofreading.

Use of this record. The top-level PDFs are intended for direct reading and download. ZIP files are for reconstruction, repair, and provenance. Large raw preservation remains on the main project record rather than being re-uploaded here.
notes: Clean author-facing Gauss record. Latest update adds small Band II source/English pilot readers and a compact current pilot artifact while leaving the large existing source/provenance artifact unchanged.
